name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-styled-classic-goomba
title: Super Mario World Styled Classic Goomba
description:
This sprite replaces the Classic Goomba sprite in SpriteTool with a more Super Mario World-esque Goomba.

It replaces the flopping Cheep-Cheep sprite, like the regular classic Goomba sprite.

It doesn't require a custom palette, because it only uses colors 1, 6 and 7 on any palette from A - D.
